title: Infinitive phrases
subtitle: Identify the governing verb before translating “to …”.
overview: The infinitive names an action and usually depends on another verb, adjective, or preposition.
Find the governing word before deciding who performs the infinitive’s action.

sections.title: Common governing patterns
rows: he or she is able to save
he or she begins to teach

items.en: We want to hear the word.
He or she is able to see the light.
He or she began to speak to them.
